name: Hungary
summary: Three MNOs: Magyar Telekom, Yettel (ex-Telenor) and One (ex-Vodafone, owned by the 4iG group, which absorbed DIGI's mobile business). NMHH auctioned 700/2100/3600 MHz in 2020 and re-awarded 900/1800 MHz in 2021; the 2100 MHz rights were extended to 2042 in 2026.

operators.name: Magyar Telekom
operators.notes: Deutsche Telekom group. Transferred a 2x5 MHz 2100 MHz block to Yettel (agreement Aug 2024, subject to NMHH approval), leaving each MNO with 2x20 MHz at 2100 MHz.

operators.name: Yettel
operators.legal: Yettel Magyarország Zrt. (formerly Telenor Magyarország Zrt.)
operators.notes: Licences were awarded to Telenor Magyarország (2014, 2020, 2021 procedures); the company rebranded to Yettel in 2022.

operators.name: One
operators.legal: One Magyarország Zrt. (formerly Vodafone Magyarország Zrt.)
operators.notes: Vodafone Hungary was acquired by 4iG (51%) and Corvinus (49%) on 31 Jan 2023 and rebranded One on 1 Jan 2025, when 4iG's DIGI Hungary retail mobile business was also folded into the One brand; 4iG planned to merge DIGI, Antenna Hungária and Invitech into One Magyarország Zrt. during H2 2025. The seed noted DIGI's own mobile network was to be shut down in June 2023 (not re-verified). DIGI's 2x5 MHz 1800 MHz right (1725-1730/1820-1825) is shown under One; the transfer of that right has not been confirmed in an NMHH document. Colour chosen for contrast (brand palette not verified). In May 2025 a share swap made 4iG Távközlési Holding Zrt. (4iG 62.1% / Corvinus 37.9%) the sole owner of One Magyarország Zrt.

bands.label: 600 MHz
bands.note: Not a mobile band in Europe; 470-694 MHz is used for DTT.

bands.label: 700 MHz FDD
bands.note: Awarded in NMHH's March 2020 5G auction (HUF 128.5bn in total across 700/2100/3600). 15-year rights (to 2035) extendable once by 5 years. The remaining 2x5 MHz (703-708/758-763) is unassigned; NMHH consulted on awarding it in Sept 2025.

bands.label: 800 MHz (B20)
bands.note: From the 2014 NMHH tender (packages A-C). Rights run to 2029 and may be extended by 5 years (NMHH: 'until 2034' including the extension). Telekom and Yettel run a MOCN for B20 outside Budapest (seed data).

bands.label: 850 MHz
bands.note: Not harmonised for mobile in Europe (800 MHz follows B20).

bands.label: 900 MHz (B8)
bands.note: NMHH 2021 auction (decision UF/25112-95/2020, 9 Mar 2021) awarded 2022-2037 rights and repositioned the 2014 rights (expiring 2029) next to each winner's new block from April 2022.

bands.label: 1.5 GHz L-band SDL
bands.note: Not assigned. At NMHH's Sept 2025 hearing operators said there is no real demand yet for 1500 MHz.

bands.label: AWS 1.7/2.1 GHz
bands.note: AWS band plan not used in Europe.

bands.label: 1800 MHz (B3)
bands.note: 2x20 MHz each for Telekom, Telenor (Yettel) and Vodafone (One) from the 2021 auction (2022-2037, extendable 5 years); Telekom 1730-1740 and DIGI 1725-1730 (UL) come from the 2014 tender (to 2029).

blocks.notes: 2014 tender package F, won by DIGI; DIGI now part of 4iG/One

bands.label: PCS 1900
bands.note: PCS band plan not used in Europe.

bands.label: 1900/2000 MHz unpaired TDD
bands.note: No current assignment for mobile broadband; not among the bands NMHH consulted on in 2025.

bands.label: 2100 MHz (B1)
bands.note: Origin: 2004 3G tender gave each operator 2x15 MHz in 1920-1965/2110-2155; the 2020 auction gave Telekom 1970-1980/2160-2170 and Vodafone 1965-1970/2155-2160. Telekom agreed in Aug 2024 to transfer one 2x5 MHz block to Yettel, so each now holds 2x20 MHz ('completely equalised', HWSW). Current block positions after the transfer (and any re-arrangement) were not found in an NMHH document; the seed's layout (Telekom 2110-2135, Yettel 2135-2150, One 2150-2170) predates the transfer.

holdings.notes: 2x15 (2004-origin, extended to 2042 in 2026) + 2x10 (2020, to 2035) minus 2x5 sold to Yettel
2x15 (2004-origin; extension to 2042 agreed, One's signature pending in the HWSW report) + 2x5 (2020, 1965-1970/2155-2160)

bands.label: 2300 MHz
bands.note: Not assigned for mobile broadband.

bands.label: 2600 MHz FDD (B7)
bands.note: 2014 tender (packages A, B, G); rights to 2029 with a 5-year extension option.

bands.label: 2600 MHz TDD (B38)
bands.note: Vodafone (One) holds 2575-2600 MHz from the 2014 tender (reported unused in the seed). A 15 MHz TDD unit offered in the 2020 auction attracted no bid.

bands.label: 3.49–3.8 GHz (n78), 2020 auction
bands.note: All 31 x 10 MHz units offered in 2020 were sold; 15-year rights (to 2035) extendable by 5 years.

bands.label: 3.4–3.49 GHz (pre-2020 rights)
bands.note: Outside the 2020 auction. The seed shows Vodafone at 3410-3520 and DIGI at 3520-3540 MHz, which conflicts with the 2020 NMHH decision (Vodafone 3490-3540), so the seed layout is not used. Holders of 3400-3490 MHz were not verified.

bands.label: 4.4–5.0 GHz (n79)
bands.note: Not assigned for mobile.

bands.label: 26 GHz (n258)
bands.note: Not assigned for 5G/MFCN. Existing 26 GHz rights are for fixed (point-to-point/multipoint) links; at NMHH's Sept 2025 hearing all holders said there is no real 5G demand and prefer to keep their microwave licences.

bands.label: 40 GHz (n259/n260)
bands.note: Not assigned; 42 GHz discussed at NMHH's 2025 hearing with no demand expressed.

bands.label: 47 GHz (n262)
bands.note: Not assigned.

notes: 700, 800, 900, 1800, 2600 and 3490-3800 MHz edges come from NMHH decisions (UF/19180-197/2019 for the 2020 auction, UF/25112-95/2020 for the 2021 900/1800 auction) and NMHH's 2014 tender results.
Conflict: the seed's 1800 MHz layout (Vodafone 1805-1825, Telekom 1825-1855, DIGI 1855-1860, Yettel 1860-1880 DL) contradicts NMHH decision UF/25112-95/2020; the regulator layout is used.
Conflict: the seed's 3.5 GHz layout (Vodafone 3410-3520, DIGI 3520-3540) contradicts the 2020 NMHH decision (Vodafone 3490-3540); the regulator layout is used and 3400-3490 MHz is left as unknown.

2100 MHz: HWSW (2026) reports each operator's 2100 MHz rights were extended to 2042 (+5 years optional) by administrative contract; Telekom and Yettel had signed, One was expected to sign within days. The 2020-auction blocks (to 2035) are separate rights.
The 2014-tender rights (800, 2600, parts of 900/1800) expire in 2029 unless extended (NMHH described them as running 'until 2034' including the extension).
missing: 2100 MHz block positions after the 2024 Telekom-to-Yettel transfer (holdings only).
Holders of 3400-3490 MHz (rights outside the 2020 auction).
Confirmation from NMHH that DIGI's 1800 MHz and any 3.5 GHz rights passed to One Magyarország.
Whether the 2014-tender rights (2029 expiry) have been extended to 2034.
Yettel Hungary's current ownership was not researched.
Carrier EARFCN/NR-ARFCN details were not compiled.
changes: Renamed Vodafone Hungary to One (rebrand 1 Jan 2025) and merged the separate Digi operator into One (DIGI's mobile business folded into One by 4iG).
1800 MHz: replaced the seed layout with NMHH's 2021 decision layout (Yettel 1710-1725 + 1760-1765, DIGI/One 1725-1730, Telekom 1730-1760, One 1765-1785 UL).
900 MHz: split into the 2021-auction and relocated 2014 blocks with exact edges (880-895 Yettel, 895-905 One, 905-915 Telekom UL); amounts unchanged from the seed.
2100 MHz: changed to holdings (2x20 MHz each) after the 2024 Telekom-to-Yettel 2x5 MHz transfer; seed positions dropped.
2600 MHz FDD: fixed the seed's invalid Yettel uplink [2560,2550] to 2550-2570.
3.5 GHz: replaced the seed layout with the 2020 auction blocks (One 3490-3540, Telekom 3540-3660, Yettel 3660-3800) and an 'unknown' entry for 3400-3490; removed DIGI's 3520-3540 block.
700 MHz: confirmed seed positions against NMHH; set 'verified'.
Added expiry dates and not-assigned entries for 600, 850, 1400, 1700, 1900, 2000tdd, 2300, 4900, 26g, 40g, 47g.
